transcript.text: Hi everyone. As you know, Line 6 is scheduled to produce 1,400 medical-device housings this week, but R-17 is temporarily unavailable. We have R-22 available as an alternate medical-grade resin for a controlled run. Before I issue the engineering authorization for the change, I need to hear from each of you on any constraints. Quality, process engineering, regulatory affairs, and production planning — please share any concerns or requirements you have so I can make a fully informed decision.

transcript.text: I checked the customer's revised control plan this morning. I should also flag that the revised plan has not yet been attached to the change-control record.
